title: Lior and the Inheritance
author: Yara Eastwick
blurb: Bram Winterbourne, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
